designationHistory.indexText: Established in 1983 when Lena Pierce donated her land to the U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service, chiefly as habitat for wintering waterfowl.

authority.citation: Land donation to the U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service

designationHistory.note: The refuge page gives only the month or year. The refuge page does not say how it was established.

sources.name: U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service: Pierce National Wildlife Refuge, About Us
Friends of the Columbia Gorge refuges (Gorge Refuge Stewards): Pierce NWR "was donated to the USFWS in 1983 by Lena Pierce"

review.note: Year confirmed by a friends-group history; administrative establishment by donation.
